research_rationale:
Identity: Executive Order 12548 of February 14, 1986, 51 FR 5985 (Feb. 19, 1986), held at jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12548.txt; it directs the Secretaries of Agriculture and the Interior to set domestic livestock grazing fees on public rangelands by a stated formula (the 1966 base of $1.23 times the Forage Value Index plus the Combined Index, divided by 100, annual change limited to 25 percent, floor of $1.35 per animal unit month), defines the terms, and preserves existing administering rules. Authority statute check: section 6(a) of Pub. L. 95-514 (43 U.S.C. 1905) fixed the fee formula for grazing years 1979 through 1985 (held current text); the order's recited authority is the Constitution and laws and sec. 1 is limited to the extent permitted by law under the various statutes the Secretaries administer, so its sec. 1 formula is an executive direction that does not rest on section 6(a); sec. 3 preserves rules on administering the formula. The eCFR authority lines of 36 CFR part 222 as of 2026-10-14 still cite the order with 43 U.S.C. 1751, 1752 and 1901. No later instrument amends, revokes or supersedes the order in held sources (OFR catalog: no note; no held order text cites it). Bounded searches read for coverage: current-law:usc (U.S. Code release point 119-121 USLM text and notes, citations of the order by number, edition current through 2026-10-09, laws enacted 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-14 not reflected), current-law:ecfr (eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 plus GovInfo CFR bulk XML, 49 titles) and later-events:ofr_catalog (Office of the Federal Register disposition notes of 6941 catalog records plus operative sentences in 17521 saved order texts).
